item.title: Lebanon State Rep says HB2847 was filed after meeting with Springfield developers, businesses
item.description: A bill filed by a Laclede County lawmaker would prohibit a 'home rule city partially located in any county between 260,000 and 300,000 residents from using the referendum process to fight back against zoning decisions by local governments, sparking opposition from residents in Springfield.

item.title: One more day before a dangerous winter storm hits the region
item.description: Winter Storm Watches have been issued for the region with winter storm impacts expected to start Friday night and continue through Sunday morning, bringing cold temperatures and light snow accumulations.
